lines.text: Some years the seed in your hand is the only thing standing between you and hunger.
He went forth weeping, bearing precious seed.
What you bury in obedience, heaven does not forget — even in the dark, even when nothing shows yet.
He shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
Whatever you're sowing in tears today, the seed is not wasted. Doubtless — you will come again with joy. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: He Shall Doubtless Come Again
story: A sower walks a dusk field in tears, scattering seed he can't afford to lose; a single seed glows in the dark earth as dawn begins; and the same field returns at golden sunrise, the sower standing amid bundled sheaves with arms raised in joy.
